summary: DEFSEC Technologies announced the addition of David Ibbetson (former General Manager of General Dynamics Mission Systems International) to its board and the retirement of Paul Mangano. This is a routine board refresh, not a forced or abrupt departure. The filing is a Form 6-K (foreign private issuer report) with a press release. No transaction terms, adviser, or strategic review are disclosed. Watch for future strategic direction under new board composition.
